newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed futures steady, seen rising soon.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed futures steady, seen rising soon.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery held steady at 1,144/1,145 rupees per quintal in a narrow band amid limited activity on Monday, traders said.
The sentiment was quiet in a poor activity but some traders were expecting prices to look up because of a falling arrivals and overseas enquiries, one operator said.
Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region fell to 3,000/4,000 bags (75 kg each) on Monday due to heavy and widespread rains, traders said.
Groundnut oil slid by a rupee to 376/377 rupees per 10 kg on light profit-taking by local stockists following reports of fresh rains in the producing regions.
"Market was firm last week due to dry spell but now prices are subdued," one miller said.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 595/600 rupees per 15 kg.
In Bombay, imported palm oil held steady at 256/257 rupees per 10 kg but sentiment was subdued as the trade is expecting arrivals of about 9,000/9,500 tonnes of imported palm oil.
